sloka: वीथीश्च गृहसंबाधाः कपिः श्रृङ्गाटकानि च ।तथा रथ्योपरथ्याश्च तथैव गृहकान्तरान् ।गृहांश्च मेघसङ्काशान् ददर्श पवनात्मजः ।। 5.53.21।।।।
transliteration: vīthīśca gṛhasaṁbādhāḥ kapiḥ śrṛṅgāṭakāni ca ।tathā rathyoparathyāśca tathaiva gṛhakāntarān ।gṛhāṁśca meghasaṅkāśān dadarśa pavanātmajaḥ ।। 5.53.21।।।।

translations.english: The son of the Windgod saw the streets with beautiful, tall mansions and houses appearing like clouds, highways and byways and secret routes.
